## Summary

Remove oil pan to access leaks at rear of engine. [t1065]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the oil pan to access leaks at the rear of the engine.
2. Check alignment on any aftermarket pans, specifically ensuring the bolt at 10 o'clock lines up correctly.

_Procedure reported by [t1065]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Note that an aftermarket oil pan may require extra attention to a specific rear mounting point. [t1065]

## Common mistakes

- Failing to align the hard-to-see 10 o'clock bolt on an aftermarket pan, leading to installation headaches. [t1065]
